Label and goto loop.description: Labeled loop using PangoScript's only conditional-loop pattern (label + If + Goto).

Counted label/goto loop.description: Counted loop using the verified label/goto pattern.

If/Goto guard.description: Guard a block by jumping forward to a final label.

OscOutTTS readback skeleton.description: Capture a property value into a var and emit it on a unique OSC address (Tier-1 readback pattern).

RegisterOscFeedback (with run-prefixed c.description: Subscribe to property-change callbacks via RegisterOscFeedback. Use a unique run-prefixed address per CLAUDE.md (registrations leak until BEYOND restart).

OnClick handler with init guard.description: Universe-button handler that exits during init and runs only on click.

Variable declaration with assignment.description: Declare and initialize a local variable in one line.

SelectZone + ControlZone destination pre.description: Select a zone for subsequent destination-scoped writes (1-indexed; SelectZone is required before ControlZone).

Zone property assignment (recommended ov.description: Direct property assignment — recommended over SelectZone+ControlZone+command when available (no destination state to manage).
